name: eur_trip_card_vs_fx
title: EUR Trip Card Versus FX
prompt: I left trip_budget.csv, bot_rates.tsv, card_terms.txt, and rate_guide.md here. Which is cheaper for the EUR trip — wallet or card — and by how much?

rate_guide.md: Use EUR spot_sell from bot_rates.tsv (column spot_sell on the EUR row).
gross = trip EUR amount * EUR spot_sell
Pick the lower net; savings = abs difference with two decimals.
Submit: EUR by N.NN   or   CARD by N.NN
run_lua tip: local rates = FILES['bot_rates.tsv']; local budget = FILES['trip_budget.csv']
card_terms.txt: Use EUR spot_sell from bot_rates.tsv (the EUR row, spot_sell column; value 36.845).
Report cheaper option: EUR by N.NN or CARD by N.NN
